model.interpretation: Approximate 95% difference threshold for two independent measurements under a normal, homoscedastic model. This is a diagnostic seal, not a reconstructed raw-data confidence interval.

hypotheses.universalSecReduction: SEC-SAXS has lower reported sigma than batch-SAXS for every protein and both Rg estimators.
hypotheses.selectiveSecReduction: SEC-SAXS has lower sigma in at least eight of ten protein-estimator comparisons and all exceptions are explicitly retained.
hypotheses.combinedAlwaysBest: The combined SAXS profile class has sigma no larger than the better of batch and SEC in every comparison.
hypotheses.numericTransferToNistVo2: The resulting thresholds can be transferred numerically to the NIST Nb-VO2 XRD grid.
